title: PointHeartExactness
statement: Let C be a preadditive category and F a field. Let omega:C to ModuleCat F be a full, faithful, additive functor. Suppose every omega(X) is finite-dimensional and every finite-dimensional F-module is isomorphic to omega(X) for some X. Then ZlPointHeartExact F omega, as defined in [def-zl-point-heart-finite-stage-data]: omega preserves and reflects finite limits, finite colimits, zero objects and short exact sequences, in addition to the assumed functor and essential-image properties. No abelian structure on C is assumed.

source.place: Paragraph 7, dimension-zero input; steps 7 of lem-zl-point-heart-finite-stage

proof.text:
factor through finitely generated modules. Full faithfulness and the stated
essential image make this factor an equivalence. Finite-dimensional modules form an
abelian category whose inclusion preserves finite limits and colimits. Transport the
abelian structure to the source. The original functor therefore preserves finite limits
and colimits, and full faithfulness reflects them. A zero object is characterized by its
unique incoming and outgoing maps; short exactness is reflected by a faithful functor
between abelian categories and preserved by an exact functor.
